children: Svetkoff Richard William, a 10% Owner, reported sales of common stock on Form 4. The transactions comprised ten unsolicited brokered sales executed between May 8, 2026 and August 4, 2026 at prices ranging from $3.95 to $10.24 per share with a weighted average price of $6.87 per share. The total proceeds from the sales were $7,221,410. Following these transactions, Svetkoff directly owned 13,119,179 common shares. The filing states the reporting person inadvertently failed to timely file the Form 4 and that the sales were made in accordance with Rule 144(f) and (g).
